title: Guitar, Piron's boat band and Rogashio
summary: Takes up guitar with Celestin, joins Piron's band on the riverboats to St. Louis, then Rogashio's 16-piece band; no records made.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Yeah, I always played the banjo.
I wonder, did you ever play guitar?

Well, I started my guitar along with Celestan's band, but I had the banjo, too. And after I left Celestan's band, well, I came back and I joined P. Ron's band. Then I was playing a straight guitar with P. Ron's band. We went on the boat and brought the boat up to St. Louis one season. That was our last season on the boat. And after I left P. Ron's band, well, I came and joined Joe Rogashio's band. That was a 16-piece band.
Did you make any of those records?
No, I never did make a record with Joe.
You kind of made some vocabulary records.
Well, during the time I was supposed to make the records, I had my money up for the records and for the transportation. We was going to New York. He had a six-piece band then.
And I left his band to go with P. Sean's band. That was a little six-piece band he had then.

Anything else about this band that P. Ron had? I remember I was up in Missouri, I think 1936 and 1937 along there. I remember seeing that boat advertisement that they advertised, the P. Ron band. And I didn't get...
You didn't get a chance to see it.
They didn't stop at our town, but a nearby town, Wednesday, Illinois would advertise it. And I wondered...
Well, we was on the three of them. We played the Capitol, the GS, and the President.
